mapper.select: SELECT oi.id, oi.create_time, oi.update_time as updateTime, oi.create_user_name, oi.create_user_id, oi.update_user_name, oi.update_user_id, oi.version, oi.is_deleted, oi.warehouse_code, oi.dict_platform, oi.platform_sku, oi.platform_sku_name, oi.product_name, oi.sku_no, oi.sku_id, oi.deliver_onway_qty as deliverOnwayQty, oi.pending_qty as pendingQty, oi.sellable_qty as sellableQty, oi.unsellable_qty as unsellableQty, oi.reserved_qty as reservedQty, oi.onway_qty as onwayQty, oi.lack_qty as lackQty, oi.frozen_qty as frozenQty, oi.shipped_qty as shippedQty, oi.download_time as downloadTime, opw.warehouse_name as name FROM overseas_inventory as oi LEFT JOIN overseas_provider_warehouse as opw on opw.platform_warehouse_code = oi.warehouse_code

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.deliver_onway_qty),0) as deliverOnwayQty, COALESCE(SUM(oi.pending_qty),0) as pendingQty, COALESCE(SUM(oi.sellable_qty),0) as sellableQty, COALESCE(SUM(oi.unsellable_qty),0) as unsellableQty, COALESCE(SUM(oi.reserved_qty),0) as reservedQty, COALESCE(SUM(oi.onway_qty),0) as onwayQty, COALESCE(SUM(oi.lack_qty),0) as lackQty, COALESCE(SUM(oi.frozen_qty),0) as frozenQty, COALESCE(SUM(oi.shipped_qty),0) as shippedQty FROM overseas_inventory as oi
